title.value: Automate small business proposals, outreach, and invoicing

introduction.value: A small business owner uses Claude for proposal writing, customer outreach, vendor management, invoicing, and website updates.

method.value: The owner says Claude became a day-to-day operator across back-office and sales work: it helped merge an old database with HubSpot using webhooks, scripts, and Python, auto-generate weekly Google ad reports, and produce HTML client proposals with fields inserted automatically. He also used it whenever he needed business analysis or a report, checked its math and outputs himself, and had it draft a work order for Codex to build a design while he monitored progress by phone.

outcome.value: He says the $200-per-month plan saved him well over $50,000 since the start of the year, and that his rebuilt system is about 95% complete. He also says there were plenty of dead ends and that he had to trace problems back and reroute them.

notes.value: His main practical constraint was untangling relationships and calculated fields in a 2015-era database, but he says avoiding a full HubSpot package saved about $25,000 a year.

source_text.body:
Automate small business proposals, outreach, and invoicing
A small business owner uses Claude for proposal writing, customer outreach, vendor management, invoicing, and website updates.
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The owner says Claude became a day-to-day operator across back-office and sales work: it helped merge an old database with HubSpot using webhooks, scripts, and Python, auto-generate weekly Google ad reports, and produce HTML client proposals with fields inserted automatically. He also used it whenever he needed business analysis or a report, checked its math and outputs himself, and had it draft a work order for Codex to build a design while he monitored progress by phone.
How it went
He says the $200-per-month plan saved him well over $50,000 since the start of the year, and that his rebuilt system is about 95% complete. He also says there were plenty of dead ends and that he had to trace problems back and reroute them.
Worth knowing
His main practical constraint was untangling relationships and calculated fields in a 2015-era database, but he says avoiding a full HubSpot package saved about $25,000 a year.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
I own a [type of] small business. Using the notes and files in [folder], draft a proposal for [client name], a follow-up outreach email to [customer list or file], and an invoice for [job and amount]. Save each as a separate document in a new folder. Don't send, publish, or change anything on my website or accounts. Show me each draft and wait for my approval first.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1vftrri/claude_from_a_small_business_perspective
